decision_description: The Phase 4 milestone consistency check flagged milestone MS3 as heuristic-inconsistent. Its due month 22 precedes the completion of all WP4 tasks at month 40. MS3 is an intermediate checkpoint, not a work package completion. Its verifiable criterion asks only that each of the three campaigns has collected at least one field round, the omics sampling protocol is delivered, and the reporting-needs assessment states what the outputs must carry. The flag is accepted as a false positive of the WP-completion heuristic. MS3 stands at month 22.
alternatives_considered: Move the MS3 due month to 40 to match the maximum WP4 task end month; rejected because it would defer an early-progress checkpoint past the completion it is meant to precede.

Add explicit depends_on_tasks and milestone_type to MS3 so the check reads it as an intermediate checkpoint; retained as a downstream schema improvement but not required to resolve the flag, since the criterion already scopes MS3 to partial campaign progress.
Escalate the flag to the operator as an unresolved timeline conflict; rejected because the heuristic, not the schedule, is the source of the mismatch.
tier_authority_applied: CLAUDE.md §7 — Phase 4 gate condition (all milestones have a defined verifiable criterion, the timeline fits within the call-specified duration, and no critical path dependency is unresolved)
rationale: The consistency check compared the MS3 due month against the maximum WP4 task end month because MS3 declares no depends_on_tasks and no milestone_type. The gantt records MS3 as an intermediate checkpoint whose criterion is partial campaign progress. Month 22 supports that criterion: tasks T4.1, T4.2 and T4.3 all start by month 18 and run to month 38, so each campaign can collect a first field round before month 22. A checkpoint on early campaign progress must fall before campaign completion. Due month 22 is therefore correct, and the heuristic flag reports a modelling gap in MS3's metadata, not a scheduling error. The Phase 4 gate condition asks for a defined verifiable criterion, which MS3 carries, and a timeline within the 48-month duration, which month 22 satisfies.
